name: aster-local
description: Read Aster holdings, source documents, processing reviews and reporting obligations through an authenticated local MCP connection.

interface.shortDescription: Sourced family office intelligence from your Aster installation.
interface.longDescription: Inspect holdings and look-through exposure, follow document processing, and review reporting deadlines and exceptions. Requires an expiring Aster read token; the plugin cannot send mail, change records, or accept financial facts.
defaultPrompt: Show ingestion progress and pending reviews.
What reporting is overdue and who owns it?
Show total exposure and the unknown portion.
